scope: R29 read-only contract review, not a new observer/controller/candidate or replay
catalog_selection: Current Office/ACL catalog has no robotics source-contract match; existing native file read/grep tools used, no custom execution

source_evidence.fact: Source sample estimate cached before arrival view; only state14 indices0..6 extrapolated, returned view timestamp changes, roll and rates held
nB combines held roll and predicted pitch; FK uses predicted absolute hip/crank coordinates
Heading outer loop uses predicted yaw; inherits C1; diagnostics combine predicted positions with held rates

epoch_contract.source_t_s: packet.time_s logical source epoch, not proof all packet channels are simultaneous instants
epoch_contract.view_t_a: packet.arrival_s passed to _predict_view; returned estimated_time_s is view time
epoch_contract.age: max(0,t_a-t_s), stale >.05 raises; does not retimestamp source measurements
held_source_fields: state14[7:14] velocity/Euler heading and pitch rates/joint rates
epoch_contract.duplicate_source_sample: update calls view from cached source self.last, no fresh derivative/KF update; not recursive propagation of last returned view

classification.definite_contract_fact: Nonuniform source-held versus arrival-predicted state view exists in current source and is consumed by C1/C2
classification.consumer_approximation: Constructed nB remains unit length but hybrid roll_source/pitch_view has no same-epoch physical attitude guarantee; predicted joint positions and held rates add constant-rate approximations
not_demonstrated: new regression against an existing explicit all-fields-synchronous specification
single cause of approximately.028rad whole-chain residual
quantitative cause of whole0/support or parking failure

roll_prediction_math.arrival_minus_source_roll_first_order: age*roll_rate_source, with unbounded-here curvature/bias and measurement-aperture terms
roll_prediction_math.scale_illustration_only: .028rad over.010s corresponds to2.8rad/s; not an observed case rate or certified error bound

saved_reduction_evidence.inference: Reported held-roll residual already uses source-epoch truth alignment. Missing arrival roll extrapolation alone does not explain that reported residual. Mixed-epoch C1 consumption may add another effect, magnitude not established here.
